Load / Recover

Study Recovery
Load and recovery options:
  • Load saved JSON study reopens a full tracker study file. Older JSON files are supported and will open in legacy view when category data is not present.
  • Drag & Drop JSON Study Loader is the preferred visual loader for OneDrive/local JSON files.
  • Autosave recoveries are local browser recovery points created while the tracker is open.
  • Load export CSV can recover study data from a tracker CSV export, but JSON is preferred for reopening studies later.
Load Study / Recover Work
Recommended recovery workflow: load an exported JSON file when reopening a study. Use autosave only when a browser tab was closed before the study was exported.

Study Validation & Data Integrity

Review Before Save
Review capture completeness and internal consistency before treating the study as a stable downtime baseline. These checks are advisory engineering controls: they flag missing traceability, unfinished records, coding gaps, invalid/overlapping timestamps, duration mismatches, event time outside observed timer windows, scope math conflicts, and reason-code definition problems. Warnings do not silently alter or exclude raw data.

Reports & Study Controls

Reports
Report and study controls:
  • SAVE STUDY in the Study Repository section is the only official study save path.
  • Export CSV / Excel / PDF creates one-off report files and does not create a resumable study record.
  • Reset Tracker clears the active working view only after confirmation.
  • Full Study JSON and legacy JSON/CSV files can be opened from the Mobile Save & Load popup.
Save Study / Export Reports
Recommended save workflow: use Select Study Folder and Save to Selected Folder on desktop Chrome/Edge when working from a local or OneDrive-synced folder. Use Export JSON as the reliable fallback download method.

Entry Mode

Study Setup
Choose how the study will be entered. Use Timer Capture for live observations with timestamps, or Manual Entry when entering a completed handwritten or spreadsheet-based study.
Timer Capture mode is active. Use Start Study and Start Downtime to capture live timestamps.

Event Log

CSV Ready
The Event Log is the main downtime record. Timer mode captures timestamps automatically. All event views stay compact with only Duration and Details; open Details to review or edit category, cause/reason code, start/stop timestamps, and notes.
  • Study timer: Press Start Study when observation begins and Stop Study when observation pauses or ends. You can start and stop the study multiple times; each run is added to the total logged study time.
  • Study timer calculations: Hidden or excluded event time is removed from study-scope calculations for included uptime, utilization, projected included-scope capacity, and estimated production loss. Stopping the study also stops any active downtime event.
  • Add Manual Row lets you enter a missed/supplemental event manually. In Timer Capture studies, supplemental rows remain included but are flagged for review because timestamp overlap cannot be verified automatically.
  • Copy Selected Columns copies only the checked columns below into an Excel-ready paste format.
  • Copy Column Selection controls what gets copied; it does not hide or delete data from the log.
  • Downtime Code options come from the Reason Code Setup section below the event log.
  • The Start/Stop Downtime bars above and below the table mirror the main capture button and span the full table width for faster logging while entering notes.
  • Downtime cannot be started unless the study timer is running. Press Start Study first so downtime is captured inside observed time.
  • Manual Entry view hides timer controls and timestamp columns so the table can be filled from handwritten studies, spreadsheets, or operator notes.
  • Collapse shows the first and most recent event while keeping the full data available in exports.
Manual Entry: Enter the total study duration manually, then add rows using event duration, category, reason code, and notes. Timer buttons and timestamp columns are hidden in this view so the sheet works like a clean manual worksheet.

Downtime Code Setup

Reason Codes
Define downtime codes here before or during data collection. Use short abbreviations such as JAM, WAIT, QA, or MAT. These codes become selectable in the Event Log and are used to build the Pareto summary.
  • Reason Code Template is populated from compatible JSON templates found under 90_TEMPLATES in the connected Study Repository. On a phone or disconnected device, a controlled template JSON can also be loaded through Mobile Save & Load. Templates are no longer baked into this HTML.
  • Category / Group is the broad downtime area shown first in the Event Log.
  • Cause Code is the specific reason selected after a category is chosen. Each cause code must be unique.
  • Code description explains what the reason code means for anyone reviewing the data later.
  • Include in Summary controls whether a code/tag is included in downtime calculations, the Pareto summary, and the executive report. Raw events and exports still keep the original code.
  • Collapse shows the first and most recent code while retaining all definitions for exports and event dropdowns.
  • Specialty code-file import/export is intentionally kept in the hidden template-maintenance workspace so normal operators use controlled repository templates.
Connect the Study Repository or use Mobile Save & Load to load a template from this device.
Paste a downtime-code table copied from Excel or a CSV file. Accepted columns include Code #, optional Category or Group, Code Abbr, Code Desc, and optional Include in Summary. Tab-separated Excel paste and comma-separated CSV are both supported.

Study-Scope Production Analysis

Study Results
Study-scope production impact is calculated from included study time, included downtime, and the entered production speed. Hidden/excluded event time remains logged, but is removed from the included study-time denominator. Projected included-scope units represent the theoretical units available at the entered speed across all included study time. Estimated production loss represents the equivalent units lost during included downtime. This basis is the same in Timer Capture and Manual Entry modes.

Analysis & Reports

Dedicated Visual Workspace
Pareto analysis and category/cause drilldown charts are kept out of the normal Review page so the study remains compact on phones. Open the visual workspace when you are ready to interpret loss concentration; all charts are read-only views of the currently included downtime scope.
Includes: included-cause Pareto table, category overview and nested Category → Cause Pareto views, production-impact summary, and category drilldowns.

Study Data & Export

Reports / Interchange
Create non-resumable report outputs here. The Study Repository and Mobile Save & Load remain the authoritative resumable-study paths. The Full Study PDF emphasizes the tabular study record; the Executive Report PDF contains the analysis charts and management summary.

Reset clears only the active working study in this browser. It does not delete an already-saved Study Repository record.

Study Repository

Mobile Save & Load

Use this on floor phones or other devices that cannot access the Study Repository. Mobile Save downloads a full-fidelity Downtime Study JSON that can be reopened later on another device.
1. Save the study to this device.Download the current full Study JSON. The file will use the location, line, date, and shift in the format shown below.
2. Transfer the downloaded file before logging off.Move or upload the LOCATION_LINE_DATE_SHIFT_DOWNTIME_STUDY.json file to your OneDrive or SharePoint files so it can be opened from another device. You can also send the JSON file through a Teams chat.
3. Load it on the next device.Open this popup and choose LOAD STUDY JSON FROM DEVICE, then select the transferred _DOWNTIME_STUDY.json file.
DATA LOSS RISK: Do not log off, sign out, clear browser data, or leave the floor device assuming its local copy is enough. If the Study JSON has not been moved to OneDrive, SharePoint, another approved storage location, or shared through Teams before you leave the device, the study may be lost.

Reason-Code Template

Load a controlled DOWNTIME_TEMPLATE__*.json file from OneDrive, SharePoint, Teams, or this device. This replaces only the reason-code table; it does not replace the current study, events, or study details.

Browser autosave/recovery is device-local crash protection only. It is not a substitute for transferring the downloaded Study JSON off the floor device. Device-loaded templates remain available for the current app session and are recorded as the study's template basis after they are applied.

Recovery Options

Compatibility recovery only. Standard study save/open and all normal report exports are now organized directly under the Data / Export tab.

Historical CSV Recovery

Use this only for historical Downtime Tracker CSV exports. CSV recovery may not restore category structure, repository identity, study segments, or every field available in a full Study JSON.
For normal continuation, use OPEN STUDY or MOBILE SAVE & LOAD. Browser autosave remains device-local crash protection only.

Template & Specialty File Maintenance

Maintenance workspace. Normal operators should load controlled templates from the dropdown. This workspace creates/updates repository template files and supports legacy reason-code interchange without changing the official study-save workflow.
